questions.objective: Name the parts of a pair.
questions.question: How many parts does a pair hold?
questions.explanation: A pair holds two parts by definition. See section 2.1

questions.objective: State what an empty list holds.
questions.question: What does an empty list hold?
questions.explanation: An empty list holds nothing at all. See section 2.1

questions.objective: Apply a stated rule to a short case.
questions.question: A step doubles whatever it is handed. It is handed a 3. What comes back?
questions.explanation: Doubling a 3 gives a 6. See section 2.1

questions.objective: Judge what a repeated step leaves behind.
questions.question: A step that leaves its input alone is run twice in a row. What is the result?
questions.explanation: A step that changes nothing changes nothing however often it is run. See section 2.1
